verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs say Terminal accepts contactless payments on a compatible iPhone or Android device through the Terminal SDK, so the phone itself acts as the reader. Founders who don't want to build an integration can take Tap to Pay payments from the Stripe Dashboard mobile app, and PIN entry is supported. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Tap to Pay in use, and detail on which devices and regions are compatible.

support.subject: As a founder, I can accept contactless card payments on an off-the-shelf phone (Tap to Pay) without buying a reader

citations.quote: Accept contactless payments using a compatible iPhone or Android device with the Stripe Terminal SDK.
Use Tap to Pay on iPhone to accept in-person contactless payments with a compatible iPhone.
Looking for a no-code solution? Accept payments from the Stripe Dashboard mobile app.
